pagination.notes: Numbers and printed pages come from the selected current aux where a statement has a label. Unlabelled environments use the active section/theorem counter and have no invented page. Physical PDF pages are not inferred from archived offsets. Rerun with --aux after the final PDF build.

hash_semantics.statement_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 active begin/end environment, including title and labels, excluding following proof and status macros. source_statement_sha256 is the same active hash for compatibility.
hash_semantics.proof_sha256: SHA-256 of the separate exact UTF-8 following proof environment before the next registered environment or section. Null means no separate explicit proof environment, not an unproved result.
hash_semantics.context: Whole active master and chapter hashes pin standing hypotheses, adjacent explanatory prose, and status macros outside environments. Byte identity is a source comparison, not a correctness verdict.
hash_semantics.historical_comparison: Only comparison fields refer to archived raw statements, proofs, old pages, or RC1 classes; they do not supply selected text.

mapping_notes: 167 environments comprise 98 result-like environments, two external standard facts, and 67 other items. These are manuscript counts, not Lean declaration counts. The finite 30 results divide into 26 Paper-III-only and four inherited-involving results. Those four comprise three inherited-only rows and one mixed row (orbit support); hence 27 rows have at least one Paper III target. Section 16 has three ordinary results with matched restored sources. Section 17 has four result environments with matched formal clauses (the norm proposition is partial) and two ordinary results without a project Lean match. The later 59 results retain ordinary proof status. Formal declarations, constructions, generated constants, and manuscript environments have different denominators.

formal_evidence.notes: This builder verifies current source and log hashes and exact names in existing passing full-build, owned-audit, and kernel-replay records. It does not itself execute Lean. Papers I–II targets remain inherited. Object hashes are observations in compiler receipts, not fresh object hashing by this builder.
